issues.legal_issue: A pre-existing local levy on goods outside the enumerated scope of an extended national excise law is not repealed merely because the levy is in the nature of an excise duty when the national law contains no express provision displacing local levies on other goods.
material_facts: A pre-existing local order imposed a royalty on bricks produced by kiln owners.
The national excise law was extended to the relevant state, and a provision of the extending legislation repealed only state laws corresponding to that national law.
Bricks were not among the goods specified as subject to duty under the national excise law.
The national excise law contained no express provision saving other goods from existing local laws or displacing those laws.
The levy was demanded after the extension of the national law, and the challenge concerned whether the earlier local order remained effective.
issues.conclusion: The local order was not a law corresponding to the national excise law and was not repealed; the levy remained effective, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 11 and 13(2) of the Finance Act, 1950 extended the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 and repealed only a pre-existing state law corresponding to that Act. Under sections 2(d) and 3(1) of the 1944 Act, excise duty applied to goods specified in the First Schedule and salt. Because the Act did not expressly displace local laws concerning other goods, the local order was not a corresponding law; the Court also referred to Article 277 as preserving a pre-existing levy where the local law did not correspond. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: challenge_to_survival_of_preexisting_local_levy and local_law_imposes_levy_on_unlisted_goods and national_excise_scope_is_enumerated and national_law_lacks_express_displacement and repeal_condition_is_correspondence_based

predicates.challenge_to_survival_of_preexisting_loc: A proceeding challenges whether a local levy imposed under an earlier local law survived the extension of a national excise law.
predicates.local_law_imposes_levy_on_unlisted_goods: A local government imposed a levy on goods that are not among the goods covered by the national excise law.
predicates.national_excise_scope_is_enumerated: The national excise law imposes duty only on enumerated goods and any expressly included additional goods.
predicates.national_law_lacks_express_displacement: The national law contains no express provision displacing local laws that impose levies on goods outside its stated scope.
predicates.repeal_condition_is_correspondence_based: The extending legislation makes repeal of an earlier local law depend on that law corresponding to the national law.

issues.definition: When a proceeding challenges the survival of an earlier local levy on goods outside an enumerated national excise law, and the national law lacks express displacement while repeal depends on correspondence, the earlier local levy remains effective.
